entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Migrator retains every pending migration's target model for the whole Migrate call #39339
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: disposing a SqliteCommand closes its open SqliteDataReader #39336
  • SQL Server: quadratic parameter-name generation across split queries with MultipleParameters (10.0.13) #39333
  • Collection `Contains` normalization rewrites any `Contains` overload and guesses the element type from the first type argument #39329
  • SQLite: JSON property names that need quoting translate to a ->> path that never matches #39328
  • Connection open count survives the reset of a pooled DbContext, so later leases keep the connection open #39327

PullRequests

Created

  • Add a validation step for the specified models. #39338
  • Keep a SqliteDataReader usable after its command is disposed #39337
    community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39332
  • Fix precompiled queries that are the receiver of an instance method call #39331
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Fix harness evaluation result discovery #39289
    area-harness
  • Bump Testcontainers.CosmosDb from 4.15.0 to 4.16.0 #39335
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26509.113 to 11.0.0-beta.26514.118 #39334
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39330
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39301

Updated

  • [release/11.0] Don't derive NULLIF nullability from its first argument #39315
